spec.explain: Illustrative toy of Adam from 1412.6980: the curve shows step = m/sqrt(v) staying bounded in a narrow valley. Watch the step value near 1 where the regime changes.

questions.q: Set v to 1 and watch the step. Do you expect a gradient ten times larger to make the step ten times larger?
Set m to 0.5 and watch the step?
Set v to 0.25 and watch the step?
Set m to -0.4 and watch the step?

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var m = state.m; var v = state.v; var thr = Math.sqrt(v); var step = m / Math.sqrt(v); var x0 = 60; var x1 = 600; var y0 = 30; var y1 = 280; var ymid = (y0 + y1) / 2; var yh = (y1 - y0) / 2; var i = 0; var mm = 0; var ss = 0; var xx = 0; var yy = 0; function fmt(q) { return Math.round(q * 100) / 100; } function X(q) { return x0 + ((q + 0.5) / 1.0) * (x1 - x0); } function Y(q) { return ymid - q * yh; } ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, ymid); ctx.lineTo(x1, ymid); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(0), y0); ctx.lineTo(X(0), y1); ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); for (i = 0; i <= 40; i = i + 1) { mm = -0.5 + (i / 40) * 1.0; ss = mm / Math.sqrt(v); xx = X(mm); yy = Y(ss); if (i === 0) { ctx.moveTo(xx, yy); } else { ctx.lineTo(xx, yy); } } ctx.stroke(); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.setLineDash; var tx = X(thr); var clipped = false; if (tx > x1) { tx = x1; clipped = true; } if (tx < x0) { tx = x0; clipped = true; } ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx, y0); ctx.lineTo(tx, y1); ctx.stroke(); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillText("adam " + fmt(thr), tx - 70, y0 - 6); if (clipped === true) { ctx.fillText("clipped", tx - 58, y1 + 44); } ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(X(m), Y(step), 6, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("step = " + fmt(step), 70, 320); ctx.fillText("m = " + fmt(m), 230, 320); ctx.fillText("v = " + fmt(v), 370, 320); ctx.font = "11px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#5c564c"; ctx.fillText("m axis", 320, 298); ctx.fillText("step 1", 8, Y(1) + 3); ctx.fillText("step no", 8, Y(-1) + 3); }
